title: llama.cpp MoE Offload: --n-cpu-moe vs the New Expert Cache (developersdigest.tech, 2026-10-09; PR #29887)
setting: EPYC 7742, RTX 4090/5090, host-RAM experts, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Q4_0 93.7 GiB
headline: 5090 30.8->67.8 tok/s (2.20x, hit 89%); 4090 25.0->39.4 (1.57x); 2x4090 34.78->64.39; R9700 simulated 11.0->14.5->27.6 at 8000/16000 MiB
transfers_to_us: no for speed; yes as hit-rate evidence
caveat: at 85% hit gain only 1.32x; 3090 gain 1-5%; regressions on multi-GPU
notes: Headline 34.8->64.4 is the 2-GPU row; 8GB numbers are another card

title: Accelerating Hybrid Inference in SGLang with KTransformers CPU Kernels (KVCache.AI, 2025-10-22)
setting: Dual Xeon 8452Y 1TB DDR5, A100/RTX4080, 8xL20; DeepSeek-V3 int4
headline: up to 20x prefill, 4x decode vs unnamed baselines; ShareGPT 227.85 tok/s total
notes: 16 tok/s is not on this page; it is in arXiv 2606.10493

title: Fiddler: CPU-GPU Orchestration for Fast Inference of MoE Models (arXiv 2402.07033)
headline: single-batch decode 1.26x avg, prefill 1.30x, beam search 11.57x vs llama.cpp
caveat: hit-rate gain over random placement only 3-5 points; needs AVX512_BF16 and ~90GB RAM
notes: 8.2x/10.1x not on the page opened; possibly an earlier version (unverified)

title: HybriMoE (arXiv 2504.05897) / HOBBIT (arXiv 2411.01433) / MoE-Infinity / DAOP
setting: HybriMoE: A6000, Xeon 5220R 10 cores. HOBBIT: RTX4090 256GB and Jetson AGX Orin, NVMe 3GB/s
headline: HybriMoE 1.33x prefill/1.70x decode vs kTransformers; HOBBIT 9.93x vs MoE-Infinity (Jetson Phi-MoE), 18.9x vs llama.cpp Jetson, 1.31-1.42x vs llama.cpp on 4090, 0.99x vs Fiddler
caveat: 9.93x is one Jetson case; score cache beats LRU by 3-8 points; HOBBIT substitutes int4/int2 experts

title: LExI: Layer-Adaptive Active Experts for Efficient MoE Model Inference (arXiv 2509.02753)
setting: 4xH100, vLLM, batch 16; Mixtral, Qwen1.5-MoE, OLMoE etc.
headline: OLMoE matches 50% intra-pruning throughput with ~10% higher accuracy (Fig 4); figures only
caveat: no CPU/memory-bound experiment; does not reduce footprint; compared to pruning not full k

title: Certain Head, Uncertain Tail: Expert-Sample for Test-Time Scaling in Fine-Grained MoE (arXiv 2602.02443, ICML 2026)
headline: greedy accuracy stable at half top-k (Fig 2a, no table); pass@n drops (Fig 2b); speed table is overhead only (<1%)
caveat: GPQA/AIME greedy accuracy is not perplexity; no speed from reduced k measured

title: MoDES: Accelerating MoE MLLMs via Dynamic Expert Skipping (arXiv 2511.15690, CVPR 2026)
headline: 97.33% vs 86.66% at 88% skipped; prefill 2.16x, decode 1.26x
caveat: VLM-specific thresholds; metric and hardware undefined on abstract page

title: llama.cpp issue #19528 Feature Request: --expert-override (closed not planned 2026-03-28)
headline: --override-kv <arch>.expert_used_count=int:N works; no benchmarks
caveat: no quality data; key is per-architecture not 'llama.'

title: Achieving Cloud-Grade SLOs for Local MoE Inference through CPU-GPU Hybrid Design (arXiv 2606.10493, OSDI 26)
headline: own: 1200 tok/s prefill, 28 tok/s INT4 decode; KT cited: >500 tok/s at 2048 prompt, ~16 or ~22 tok/s decode
notes: 500 and 16 tok/s are KTransformers numbers cited in prose; paper gives two decode figures for KT (16 and 22)

title: Running DeepSeek-V4-Flash and Kimi-K3 on Consumer Hardware with SSD Expert Pack (SGLang/WiCi, 2026-08-29)
setting: Ultra5 230F, 32GB RAM, NVMe, RTX 5090 32GB; Ollama/llama.cpp --cpu-moe baselines
headline: decode 0.288->1.992 (6.92x), 0.282->1.846 (6.55x); Kimi 3.30-3.52x; hit 17-54%
caveat: no ablation isolating repack from GPU cache; baselines at 0.29 tok/s; miss path not overlapped

title: gpt-oss-120b on an 11.3 GB Phone (BigMoeOnEdge docs)
setting: Android 12GB phone, gpt-oss-120b Q4_K_M 58.46GB, 2000 MiB cache
headline: best 2.191 tok/s (top-k 2); top-k 4 1.300; cache off 0.711; mmap 11-13 s/token
transfers_to_us: partly (regime match, not the tested mechanism)
caveat: 3.2x mixes sweeps/protocols; throttled; one-prompt quality check
notes: O_DIRECT was applied to dense weights, not experts or 'routing weights'

title: Zero Python, Zero Frameworks, 397 Billion Parameters: Flash-MoE (urandom.io, 2026-03-22)
setting: M3 Max 48GB, 17.5GB/s SSD, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, 512 experts, K=4
headline: 4.4 tok/s 4-bit; 5.74 tok/s 2-bit (breaks JSON)
caveat: ~35GB OS page cache (71% hit); custom caches slower; fast SSD
notes: 5.5GB resident and Lilting part not on page; whether K=4 is reduced is unverified

title: Running a 26B MoE on an 8 GB Jetson by streaming experts from SSD (dev.to, Anish Shrestha)
setting: Jetson Orin Nano Super 8GB, NVMe, Gemma 4 26B-A4B Q4 QAT
headline: 2.95 tok/s overlap, 2.23 off, vs 1.94 --cpu-moe mmap; IO-bound ~5 tok/s
caveat: small model, mmap baseline, 32-slot LFU cache is part of the design; cold prefill 1/4 speed

title: Apple LLM in a flash + HN comment (Roxxik) on io_uring layer in llama.cpp fork
headline: slightly under 2x tok/s vs mmap (search summary)
caveat: url is a user feed; fetch returned 404
notes: only a search-engine summary of the comment was seen

title: LLM in a flash: Efficient LLM Inference with Limited Memory (arXiv 2312.11514v3)
setting: OPT 6.7B etc.; M1 Max, M2 Ultra, RTX 4090; half model in DRAM
headline: I/O 2196 ms naive -> 87 ms; CPU total 3182->669 ms (~4.8x), GPU 2218->84 ms (~26x); 32 KiB chunks, 32 threads
caveat: dense FFN neuron sparsity with predictor, not MoE; windowing is a cache; theoretical-best naive baseline

title: The Other Half of the Memory Wall: Serving 35B MoEs from SSD with Trained Routing Prediction (Edge0, arXiv 2609.18063)
setting: 24GB Mac mini M4 Pro, MLX, 35B-A3B int4 19.5GB
headline: 20.4 tok/s vs 3.9 baseline; OpenCompass 79.2 vs 83.2
caveat: needs trained prerouter and LoRA per model; Apple only
notes: body says 3.9 tok/s baseline is fully resident 18.2 GiB, not on-demand streaming
